purpose: Develop and optimize the paper concept; do not treat missing paper parameters as prerequisites

baseline.target_mode: TE0; mode identity must be verified

stages.name: signed_voltage_baseline
stages.acceptance: Require same mode across voltage points and mesh/time convergence before quantitative sensitivity claims

stages.name: electrode_screening
stages.strategy: one-variable screening first, then refine promising combinations
stages.effective_distance_role: surrogate field-strength parameter, not a physical gap optimization
stages.constraint: Electrode and coupling sectors must not overlap; use actual topology when evaluating this constraint
stages.acceptance: Effective-field screening must be checked with electrostatics and optical electrode loss before physical electrode ranking

stages.name: coupling_and_cascade
stages.strategy: Fit a reduced coupled-ring model to validated single-ring spectra; validate selected full-wave cases
stages.ranking: Pareto comparison; no unprovided objective weights or target error tolerances assumed
stages.bias_control_mapping: Fit from zero-voltage resonance and selected laser; do not hard-code positive bias plus control

provenance: Candidate sets and stage ordering are exploratory engineering choices, not values asserted by the paper
